verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no registrable outbound HTTP webhooks that a programmatic consumer can subscribe to for Copilot events. The closest item is Automations, which run Copilot cloud agent in response to repository events. That is an inbound trigger, an adjacent feature rather than an outbound webhook subscription, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
